 ## C: authenticated reconstruction, then strict frame

+C requires its fixed committed binding, both A receipts and both B inventory receipts. Every file is bounded, canonical and hash-pinned; prior pairs are complete canonical equals with original producer identities. Each B receipt's embedded A pin pair must exactly match C's selected A pair. Closed outer and inner schemas reject added/ill-typed exposure fields, source drift, scientific counts, malformed lineage or nonqualifying status before target access. Completed historical A/B ledgers also satisfy necessary counter consistency: write M for member opens, D for decompressions, U for UTF-8 decodes and X for XML parses, with each started/completed pair equal and exactly integer. A requires M=D=U=X>=6, from four distinct mandatory metadata parts and two role reads. For B, s is 1 exactly when the complete inventory contains shared-string cells: M=D>=6+s and U=X=M+2, from two additional cached-role XML parses. Authenticated same-source A/B pairs additionally require M_B=M_A+s. The earlier G34 header replay is separate and sheet-name projection adds no such operations. These rules apply only to completed historical A/B, never failure prefixes or full C counts. They are necessary internal consistency checks, not proof that historical operations occurred. A public receipt is accepted as a prior only after root's external operation acceptance described below.
 
 The distinct binding schema `li_v3.inventory_frame_binding.v2` uses `prior_inventory_sha256`; it never supplies or invents a historical strict-documentary receipt. It requires `unbound_row_policy=UNRESOLVED`, `excluded_sheets=[]`, and explicit per-sheet mode `DOCUMENTARY_BOUND_METADATA` or `STRUCTURAL_ONLY_UNASSIGNED`. Every A-manifest non-documentary sheet must be included by exact name. Complete coverage and all mode/binding shapes are checked before any record member opens. A name, ordinal, visibility or relationship never supplies a scientific role.
